sources.title: Gemma 4 — Google DeepMind
sources.snippet: Safety Gemma 4 models undergo the same rigorous infrastructure security protocols as our proprietary models. By choosing Gemma 4, enterprises and sovereign organizations gain a trusted, transparent foundation that delivers state-of-the-art capabilities while meeting the highest standards for security and reliability.

sources.title: ai-club-rtx3090/models/gemma-4-31b/README.md at master - GitHub
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 31B — on 2× RTX 3090 Run Gemma 4 31B — with vision and tool calling — on 2× RTX 3090s, on stock vLLM v0.24. (overlay-free). ⚠️ Single-card boot OOMs on 24 GB Ampere regardless of KV format. Needs ≥32 GB single-card (validated on RTX 5090 by @apnar).

sources.title: Gemma 4 | Google AI Edge | Google for Developers
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 models are designed to deliver frontier-level performance at each size, targeting deployment scenarios from mobile and edge devices (E2B, E4B) to consumer GPUs and workstations (26B A4B, 31B). They are well-suited for reasoning, agentic workflows, coding, and multimodal understanding.
